It is completely understandable that you are feeling hurt and angry right now. Seeing your friends go out without you, especially after they frequently cancel your plans, is incredibly painful and feels like a major betrayal of your trust. Your feelings of frustration are completely valid. 

Before sending that group text, it might be helpful to take a step back and give yourself a little time to process these intense emotions. Firing off a message while you are feeling this angry might escalate the situation in a way that doesn't actually give you the closure or respect you deserve. When you feel a bit calmer, you might consider reaching out to the friend you feel closest to for a one-on-one conversation to express how their actions made you feel. Alternatively, this might be a moment to reflect on whether these friendships are truly bringing you the support, inclusion, and mutual respect you deserve in your life.
